messages:
Alex K: :rotating_light: 09:12 UTC - multiple customers reporting 504 / gateway timeouts on hosted inference. Spike started ~09:08. Error rate ~12% for POST /v1/generate. Seeing surge from a handful of tenants (acme-*, beta-*) but also some noise from others. Logs show upstream connect timeouts from auth-proxy -> gateway.

Maria P: I see the same in console metrics - p50 latency is fine but p95/p99 shoots up. Rate limiters look healthy. Rolling deploy of auth-proxy went out at 09:05 (canary then all regions). Suspect rollout regression. @Infra Oncall can you verify the auth-proxy pods and connection pool sizes?

Infra Oncall: checking k8s now. Auth-proxy rollout completed at 09:06. Several pods in eu-west are showing repeated 502/504 to gateway. I can see connection reset logs and a lot of TLS handshake timeouts to upstream. Dumping last 50 lines:

```
2026-03-14T09:09:21Z auth-proxy[proxy-5f6d7] ERROR upstream connect timed out after 10s for backend gateway-us-east-1:443
2026-03-14T09:09:21Z auth-proxy[proxy-5f6d7] WARN connection pool exhausted: max_conns=100 current=101
2026-03-14T09:09:22Z gateway[gw-2a1] INFO client=acme-token service=hosted-inference status=504 upstream=auth-proxy
```

Jamal S: That pool exhaustion line is suspicious. We recently changed the default max connections in the proxy config to 100 from 250 to be conservative. Might be too low for busy tenants. Can we temporarily bump it? Also, were keepalive settings changed in the rollout? I recall a tweak to idle timeouts.

Sophie L: Confirmed config diff in PR #5123: `max_connections: 100`, `idle_timeout: 5s` (was 60s). The intent was to free sockets quickly but that may blow up backend reconnects.

Maria P: Immediate mitigation suggestion: rollback auth-proxy to previous config (or scale up replicas) and increase connection pool. We should also enable aggressive prefix-caching in gateway as fallback. Who can do the rollback now?

Infra Oncall: I'm initiating a rollback to the previous ReplicaSet in eu-west and us-east. Also kicking a hotfix to set `max_connections: 300` and `idle_timeout: 30s` as an interim. Will remove the change to idle_timeout.

incident-bot: ACTION - rollback started by Infra Oncall at 09:18 UTC. Notifying oncall and owners.

Alex K: Thanks. Support teams, please set expected customer-facing ETA ~09:30-09:40 and add a note to status page: "Intermittent timeouts; investigating." Keep billing safe — we should not auto-churn requests yet.

billing-bot: NOTE - we've seen an uptick in 4xx->5xx conversions affecting billing counters. Flagging for manual review to avoid overbilling. Holding any rate-limited refund triggers.

Jamal S: After rollback, auth-proxy pods are green and 5xx rate dropped to <1% at 09:34. p99 latency improving. I still see a small tail for long-lived clients due to stale TLS sessions; we should consider bumping keepalive on gateway side to reduce reconnect churn.

Sophie L: Action items for postmortem: 1) Revert aggressive idle_timeout change in default config. 2) Add a preflight load test for connection-pool-sensitive config changes. 3) Update deploy playbook to include a quick traffic spike test for global canary. 4) Add metric alert for connection_pool_exhausted.

Alex K: Agreed. Also add: 5) Add a billing-safety check so billing-bot doesn't treat transient 5xx bursts as real usage; 6) Run retrospective with both infra and product on why this config went to prod without load simulation.

Maria P: I'll own the follow-up doc and schedule the postmortem meeting. Quick notes: timeline, screenshots of metrics, config diff, rollback commands used, affected tenants list (acme-*, beta-launch-3). Will share draft in #postmortems by EOD.

Infra Oncall: Closing warroom. Monitoring for 30m. Will reopen if regression seen. :white_check_mark:
